turns.text: So, don't worry about being ideal.
turns.zh: 所以，别担心说得不够完美。

turns.text: Just focus on communicating and having fun with the language.
turns.zh: 只要专注于交流，享受用这门语言的乐趣就好。

turns.text: Are you ready to take your English conversations to the next level?
turns.zh: 你准备好把你的英语对话提升到下一个水平了吗？

turns.text: Okay, so our first conversation today is between two co-workers who are meeting for the first time at a new job.
turns.zh: 好，那我们今天的第一段对话，是两个同事在新工作中第一次见面的场景。

turns.text: Right, we have Sarah who's been working at the marketing company for about 6 months and David who just started this week.
turns.zh: 对，我们有莎拉，她在这家营销公司工作了大约六个月，还有大卫，他这周才刚入职。

turns.text: This is a really common situation, you know, when you're the new guy at work and trying to fit in with your colleagues.
turns.zh: 这是特别常见的情况，你知道吧，当你是公司里的新人，想努力融入同事圈子的时候。
